2608.06329.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Benchmarks for Conversational Agents
2608.06329.paper_summary: Task-oriented conversational agents are evaluated using curated or automatically generated benchmarks, yet benchmark quality is rarely assessed. Poor benchmarks may contain inconsistent tasks, simplistic scenarios, or limited policy coverage, leading to unreliable evaluations. We introduce a reference-free framework that uses LLM judges to assess benchmark consistency, complexity, and policy coverage, while providing actionable diagnostics of weaknesses. We validate the framework by demonstrating agreement with independent human annotations and by evaluating benchmarks generated by LLMs of varying capabilities, as well as benchmarks subjected to controlled quality-degrading perturbations. Across domains and judge models, the proposed metrics consistently distinguish between benchmark quality levels. We further demonstrate the framework's applicability to manually curated benchmarks. Our framework offers a practical approach for evaluating synthetic and manually curated conversational-agent benchmarks.
2608.06329.paper_summary_zh: 任務導向的對話代理使用精心策劃或自動生成的基準進行評估，但基準的質量卻很少被評估。劣質的基準可能包含不一致的任務、簡化的場景或有限的政策覆蓋，導致不可靠的評估。我們引入了一個無參考的框架，利用大型語言模型（LLM）評估基準的一致性、複雜性和政策覆蓋，同時提供可行的弱點診斷。我們通過展示與獨立人類標註的一致性以及評估由不同能力的LLM生成的基準來驗證該框架，還有經過控制質量降級擾動的基準。在各個領域和評估模型中，所提出的指標始終能區分基準質量的不同水平。我們進一步展示了該框架對手動策劃基準的適用性。我們的框架為評估合成和手動策劃的對話代理基準提供了一種實用的方法。
